parsed.notes:
Minimum Qualifications supplies required skills; Preferred Qualifications supplies optional skills. Responsibilities alone do not establish requirements.
Retrieval methods is broader than RAG or vector search and is left unmapped; GraphRAG explicitly supports optional RAG.
Agent-to-agent frameworks is left unmapped rather than inferring a broader agents or multi-agent-systems requirement.
Deploying and running AI at scale is read literally as asking for both AI deployment and production AI operations.
Security requirements do not specify guardrail implementations, so LLM guardrails is not inferred.
AI and ML are not grouped as alternatives because the available AI/ML taxonomy entry is broad and ML is a specific skill.
LLM-as-judge and holdout experiments are retained as unmapped techniques rather than silently adding taxonomy aliases. Domain knowledge, strategy, soft skills, and years of experience are excluded from skill criteria.
